resources.string: Masroof reads bank SMS messages on your device and turns them into organized financial transactions.
Processing happens locally on your device. Masroof does not need permission to send SMS.
Masroof needs SMS access to detect bank transactions and import them into the app.
From which date should transactions be imported?
No messages found in the selected period. Try an earlier date.

Tracked accounts are used to classify transfers (between my accounts / external). Stopped accounts are not counted as yours.
Account ...%1$s will no longer count as one of yours — its transfers may be classified as external.
Tracked cards appear on the dashboard. Stopped cards are hidden.

Track spending from bank SMS — without linking your bank account.
Messages are parsed locally on your device. Financial SMS content is not uploaded. App updates may contact GitHub using your personal token.

%1$s will no longer count as one of your loans — it will be hidden from the loans summary.
Re-parses bank SMS stored on the device. Useful after an app update or if an amount or category looks wrong — without re-importing from the phone.
Example: USD purchases convert to SAR when the exchange rate is in the message.

Public repos can be checked without a token. For a private GitHub repo, enter a read-only personal access token (PAT). Updates download from GitHub Releases without Google Play, and checks repeat automatically once a day.
Stable receives official releases only. Nightly receives the latest test or stable build.
